functionality.rationale: Incorrect schema rules could misclassify feature work as a bugfix or accept a defect task without reviewable evidence.

security.rationale: Security defects must not bypass specialized risk gates by using incomplete or untrusted defect metadata.

performance.rationale: Schema validation operates on small task records and adds no product runtime work.

compatibility.rationale: All existing schema version 1 and 2 records must remain valid without bulk migration.

concurrency.rationale: This task validates immutable record content and introduces no concurrent state.

platform.rationale: The schema and generator use portable Python and shell constructs already exercised by repository CI.

persistence.rationale: Task records are durable lifecycle evidence, so malformed schema version 3 data must fail closed.

adr.rationale: Typed defect handling changes the durable compatibility policy shared by every workstream.

architecture.rationale: Runtime module boundaries and dependency direction are unchanged.

roadmap.rationale: This governance capability does not itself deliver a product milestone.
